cohort: Preterm infants (<35 weeks' gestation) without congenital anomalies receiving active intensive care in US neonatal intensive care units, who were discharged home or died in the birth hospital between January 1, 2008, and December 31, 2018.
finding: From 2008 to 2018, there was a significant decrease in the use and duration of mechanical ventilation (MV) and an increase in the use and duration of noninvasive ventilation (NIV), resulting in an overall increase in respiratory support duration for US preterm infants.
